guard_pose: calm upright stance facing right, arms lowered with both hands in the pockets of his long white coat

jab: fast open-hand strike: keeps one hand in his pocket and snaps the other hand straight forward in a precise flat-handed thrust, then returns it to his pocket
jab2: backhand swat: sweeps the same hand forward in a cold backhand strike with a slight twist of the hips, the other hand still in his pocket, then back into the stance
jab3: precise kick: lifts the front leg and kicks straight forward at belly height with a flash of green spiritual energy, hands in his pockets, then back into the stance
ftilt: stepping kick: steps forward and kicks straight ahead at chest height with no wasted motion, hands staying in his pockets, then back into the stance
utilt: rising hand strike: takes one hand out of his pocket and swings it in an arc from low in front straight up above his head, then puts it back in his pocket
dashattack: Sonido rush: glides forward in a blur and rams ahead shoulder first wrapped in a flash of green spiritual energy, then stops and stands back in the calm stance with his hands in his pockets
fsmash: charged palm strike: draws one hand back as green spiritual energy gathers around it, then thrusts the flat hand straight forward at full extension with a burst of green energy, then puts the hand back in his pocket
usmash: upward strike: crouches slightly, then springs up on his toes and strikes straight above his head with one hand in a burst of green spiritual energy, then lands back in the calm stance
dsmash: low split kicks: drops low and kicks fast in front at foot level, then spins and kicks behind him, green energy flashing, hands in his pockets, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: spins once in mid-air with his coat flaring as a ring of green spiritual energy flashes close around his body, then opens up again
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a burst of green spiritual energy, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: Cero: calmly takes his right hand out of his pocket and points one finger forward, a sphere of green spiritual energy gathers at the fingertip, then a short thick green Cero beam fires straight forward, then he lowers the hand back into his pocket
sspecial: Sonido: vanishes in a flicker leaving a fading afterimage, reappears and drives a flat-handed thrust straight forward with a flash of green spiritual energy, then returns to the calm stance
uspecial: upward Sonido: vanishes in a flicker from the stance, then reappears in mid-air with a flash of green energy around his body, coat fluttering, hands still in his pockets, legs hanging
dspecial: Bala: takes one hand out of his pocket and snaps the fist straight forward, two small compact bullets of green spiritual energy shoot out from his knuckles, then he puts the hand back in his pocket
ultimate: Cero Oscuras: raises his right hand and points one finger forward, a black sphere edged with green gathers and swells at the fingertip, crackling, then a thick black beam outlined in green blasts straight forward, then he lowers the hand back into the calm stance
w0_nspecial: Luz de la Luna: a long javelin of bright green light forms in his right hand, he draws it back over his shoulder and hurls it straight forward with an overhand throw, then returns to the stance
w0_ultimate: Lanza del Relampago: in his Segunda Etapa, black bat wings unfold behind him, he raises his right hand and a long crackling spear of cyan energy forms in his grip, sparks of cyan lightning dancing along it, he leans back and hurls it forward with a powerful overhand throw, then the wings fold away and he returns to the stance
w1_ultimate: Segunda Etapa: a pillar of black and green spiritual energy rises around him, his hair grows long, black fur covers his legs, black bat wings and a long thin tail unfold behind him, a ring of green-black energy blasts outward close around him, then the burst settles, the form fades and he returns to the calm stance
